methodologyNotes: Residential proxy pricing was collected on 2026-06-15 from each vendor's official pricing page where the page returned usable USD figures. For Bright Data, the residential-proxies product page returned pricing (brightdata.com/proxy-types/residential-proxies); the main /pricing page only showed category links without figures. For Oxylabs, the product detail page (oxylabs.io/products/residential-proxy-pool) returned tier data; the main /pricing page showed only starting rates. For NetNut, the homepage returned a pricing table; dedicated /pricing and /pricing-residential-proxies paths returned 404. Corroboration was sourced from proxyway.com reviews (accessed same date) and aimultiple.com/proxy-pricing. All prices are monthly USD for the lowest published committed tier; for usage-metered plans the lowest flat/committed monthly amount is used as monthlyUsd with per-GB/per-IP unit rates noted in the notes field. HIPAA/BAA are not standard in the proxy industry and are null unless explicitly stated. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony). billingModel is 'flat' for fixed monthly commitments and 'custom' for quote-only or fully usage-metered tiers with no published floor. annualDiscountPct is noted where both monthly and annual rates are published.
